name: io.github.caiderek/logcarverguard
title: LogCarverGuard
description: Guardrail for AI agents on SQL Server: statement blocking, optional read-only mode and an audit log.

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: SQL Server connection string the statements run as. Example: Server=localhost;Database=MyDb;Integrated Security=true;TrustServerCertificate=true

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow queries only (SELECT without INTO; remote sources such as OPENQUERY are blocked). Leave unset for the default guard rules.
